title: DepositFieldTable
description: Shape of a star system's PUBLIC deposit layout, data/world/deposits/{star_system_id}.json. schema_version 2 (p1-03, ADR-0015 section 2): the server-only mineral_id and initial_reserve_kg moved to DEPOSIT_RESERVE (data/world/deposit-reserves/{star_system_id}.json), so this file carries nothing a client must not see and is copied to the client verbatim. A data kind is entirely public or entirely server-only - never 'a field the client promises not to read' (that was the p1-02 leak). Boot-time checks beyond this schema (all boot failures, spec p1-02 I-38 extension, p1-03 spec section 4.8): star_system_id equals a loaded star system; a DEPOSIT_RESERVE file with the same star_system_id exists and its deposit_id set equals this file's id set exactly (both directions); ids unique; |position| + radius_m + mining_range_from_surface_m <= soft_boundary_radius_m; mining zones of two deposits do not overlap. Positions are system-local metres (ADR-0009 section 1). 단위 접미사 규약: 수치 필드 이름이 단위로 끝난다 (_m, _mps, _s, _kg).

schema_version.description: 2 since p1-03 (ADR-0015). A version 1 file (with mineral_id/initial_reserve_kg) is a boot failure - data files are not stored history, so there is no upcaster.

display_name.description: Region-only name; must not reveal the mineral.
